newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Plane crashes in Sao Paulo.
newsitem.headline: Plane crashes in Sao Paulo.

text.p: A plane crashed near a Sao Paulo subway station, police said Thursday.
An airport official described the plane as a Fokker-100 airliner carrying 90 people. It crashed shortly after taking off from Sao Paulo's Congonhas regional airport.

A police spokesman said the airplane was operated by Brazilian carrier TAM and it crashed in a heavily populated suburban area of the city but he did not have any immediate details on the number killed or injured.
The plane was headed for Rio de Janeiro and news reports said the plane crashed into homes near the airport.
